sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply; instead, the score reflects whether market expectations are stretched or depressed heading into the print. The document describes a stock that has already rallied nearly 26% year-to-date on turnaround optimism, with historical patterns showing SBUX underperforms after earnings 55% of the time with median one-day declines of 4.4%, indicating a demanding bar with little room for a soft print. Additionally, structural headwinds in China (a price war with Luckin undercutting by 30-40%) and margin pressure from a $500 million labor investment initiative are explicitly flagged as persisting into Q3, further depressing the forward outlook.
